description: Switch the user's beep.me reminders on with the 6-digit code from beep.me's confirmation email, so they don't have to leave the chat to click its link. Only with a code the user has typed into the chat themselves: never guess one, never reuse a code from earlier. Pass the address the reminder was made with. Wrong codes are limited; after that, the link in the same email still works.

code.description: The 6-digit code from the email, exactly as the user typed it.

email.description: The user's own email address, exactly as they gave it.

name: confirm_email
title: Confirm my email with the code
